stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A community refrigerator became popular, but some people left food without labels.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Public Refrigerator Rule: A community refrigerator became popular, but some people left food without labels.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Public Piano Rule」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The City Cooling Center」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Community Fridge」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
